_comment: Import schemes contributed by tish-agb. A tish game that depends on tish-agb (via package.json tish.rustDependencies) picks these up automatically — no per-game config, and no edits to the tish compiler. `asset:` bakes a sprite image (PNG/aseprite) into the ROM and binds each imported name to an i32 sprite-sheet handle for sprite_new(). `background:` bakes a full-screen (>=240x160) tile image and binds an i32 handle for bg_new().

schemes._bgtiles_comment: A background tileset WITHOUT agb's `deduplicate`. Use this, not `background:`, when the game addresses tiles by INDEX through `tilemap_set` / `tilemap_new`: deduplicate collapses identical 8x8 tiles and shortens `tile_settings`, while the index math assumes the full grid, so every tile past the shortened length silently fails to draw. It costs ROM (no dedup) and buys correct indexing.
schemes._sheet_comment: `sheet:path@N` bakes a PNG strip as N×N cells (default @16 when omitted). Prefer this over the legacy `sheet32:`/`sheet64:`/`sheet8:` prefixes — same bake, one scheme. Non-square cells (`sheet3264:`, `sheet6432:`) still need their own prefix.
schemes._sheet8_comment: `sheet8:` is `sheet:` at 8x8. It exists for the falling-block genre, where a cell IS a hardware tile: the moving piece has to be sprites rather than tilemap writes (a tilemap write measured ~310 ticks, and a piece plus its ghost is 16 of them per horizontal move, which is over a whole frame), and a 16x16 sprite carrying an 8x8 block wastes four times the sprite VRAM per frame.
schemes._map_comment: map: is the LOW-LEVEL path and a game should not use it — author levels in Tiled and import them with `scene:`, which bakes the tileset and the map together from one .tmj and is what every example does. This scheme takes an ALREADY-BAKED blob (include_bytes!) and leaves you to pair it with a `background:` atlas by hand, which means nothing checks that the two agree, and a second `background:` on screen will fight it for the 16 shared background palettes. It exists for blobs produced outside Tiled — a converter, a test fixture, a generator — and for the tools that write them. Blob layout: `do_map_stream_resolved` in crates/tish-agb/src/lib.rs.
schemes._chip_comment: chip: compiles a readable chiptune tracker text (tempo/wave/inst/chN rows) into static note data and binds an i32 handle for chip_play(). The song plays on the GBA's four PSG hardware channels, so it costs the ROM its notes (kilobytes) instead of a recording (megabytes) and costs no per-frame mixing at all. See crates/tish-gba-scenepack/src/chippack.rs for the format.
schemes._deck_comment: deck: compiles a deck song (gameBoyDmg + gbaDirectSound only) into a DeckSong for deck_play(). Tracks may set layer/intensity 0..3 for crossfading intensity stems (deck_set_intensity). Soft ADSR/vib/arp/pitch-drop run per frame on PSG and DirectSound wavetable voices. See docs/deck.md.
schemes._sheet3264_comment: 32x64 cells. A 16x40 SRPG unit frame — ten tiles as 8/16/16px rows — which matches no GBA sprite size, so it is padded into the smallest cell that holds it.
schemes._font_comment: font:path@N bakes a TTF at N pixels (selective glyph set) plus FontMetrics for text_width/wrap. Binds an i32 handle for text_draw()/ui_text(). Example: font:../../../assets/fonts/tinypixel.ttf@7. Bare font:path (no @N) defaults to 16. Pick N matching the face's native pixel size (3x3-mono=4, tinypixel=7, ark-pixel=10, pixelify=11, undead-11=11, peaberry/monogram/m3x6/pixelify-bold=16, …).
schemes._emoji_comment: emoji: points at a DIRECTORY of per-codepoint PNGs (the vendored SerenityOS set at assets/emoji/serenity). It bakes ONLY the emoji this program's strings use into one colour sprite strip and registers it as the GLOBAL emoji fallback — every text_draw/hud_text call then renders those emoji inline wherever the font has no glyph. One import turns emoji on for the whole game; no per-font setup.

strings._comment: strings: bakes a multi-language string table into ROM from a .strings file ([lang] sections whose LINE POSITION is the id). The macro refuses to compile a file whose translations disagree on how many strings exist, so an id is valid in every language or in none. Read with str_get(handle, lang, id).

schemes._isobattle_comment: isobattle: bakes a whole SRPG-style battlefield from a Tiled .tmj — the isometric floor background PLUS the per-cell terrain/elevation/walkability and unit spawns the grid-battle engine needs. The imported handle is loaded with isob_load(handle); the floor is bg_new(isob_board_bg(handle)); spawns are read with isob_spawn_count/col/row/cls/team. Walkability is a `walkable=false` tile property on the terrain tileset. No import script, no generated .tish data module — the Tiled files are the source.
